Three pressure gauges (PG 206-08, PG 206-09, and PG 206-19) are specified for the Ullage Cleaning System.
All gauges have a Bourdon tube pressure element made of 316 SS.
The design pressure ranges from 200 to 400 psig with an operating temperature of up to 600°F.
Gauges are mounted locally and feature shatterproof glass and stainless steel movement.
All gauges require calibration by the vendor, and a certificate of calibration is required.
